title: London-based Jack & Jill, which offers Jack, an AI agent for job seekers, and Jill, an agent for companies, raised a $40M Series A, after raising $20M in 2025 (Chris Metinko/Axios)
summary: Chris Metinko / Axios: London-based Jack & Jill, which offers Jack, an AI agent for job seekers, and Jill, an agent for companies, raised a $40M Series A, after raising $20M in 2025 — Jack & Jill, a London-based agentic job-finding platform, raised a $40 million Series A led by Air Street Capital, CEO Matt Wilson tells Axios Pro exclusively.
